text:
Maya: Heads-up: quick design review — compact rules list feels cramped when preview is open. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/ux/1965432100.png
Ben: I noticed that too. In compact mode the priority handle overlaps the preview chip at narrower widths.
Carlos: Frontend note: dragging reorder uses pointer-events while preview animates, leads to dropped reorders on slow devices. Could debounce the preview or disable pointer-events during drag.
Priya: Accessibility nits: keyboard reorder needs clear instructions and focus ring is gone in compact. Also preview updates should use aria-live="polite" so assistive tech knows when simulation completes.
Alice: Microcopy idea for validation: Instead of "Rule invalid" use "Rule conflict: this rule will never match because a higher-priority rule captures the same traffic." It's actionable.
Maya: Love that. Make it shorter maybe: "Conflicting priority — higher rule matches the same requests." Thoughts?
Ben: Short and actionable works. Also for the preview shimmer, let's change label from "Simulating..." to "Previewing policy behavior" — more descriptive.
Carlos: Implementation detail for keyboard reorder:
```
<button aria-label="Move rule down" data-action="move-down">↓</button>
```
We should also add `aria-describedby` pointing to a live region that updates position.
Priya: Contrast check: priority badge color fails WCAG AA on dark mode at 12px. Increase contrast or add a dotted underline for low-contrast cases. Also ensure focus outline is at least 3px.
DesignBot: Simulation metrics: when running preview with 10k iterations we see non-deterministic ordering in ~0.8% cases due to tie-breaker sampling. Suggest adding a "deterministic" toggle that seeds the sim.
Maya: Nice catch @DesignBot. Can we show a tooltip when nondeterministic: "Results may vary — enable deterministic sim for stable ordering" :information_source:
Ben: Also propose a small UX change: collapse preview into a bottom-docked pane on small screens rather than overlay. Less layout shift.
Maya: OK — next steps: Carlos to prototype keyboard `aria` changes + focus styles, Priya to run contrast/focus audit, Alice to land microcopy tweaks, Ben to mock bottom-dock preview. I'll sync on Friday for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
